## Topic Area

We decided to work with social media usage as a topic area due to how prevalent it is in daily life, especially in our generation where we grew up with it. Additionally, we feel social media has a number of effects on people that we would like to try and visualize with data.

## Research Question

How does social media affect those who frequently use it vs those who rarely use it?
